inputs_used: narrow WEB canonical passages named in canonical_relations

routing_policy.primary_unit: Return the complete routed unit containing the hit; never return a named proof-text verse alone.
routing_policy.neighbor_hydration: For a high-risk hit, hydrate every unit named in mandatory_parent_context before ranking or synthesis.
routing_policy.canonical_hydration: Canonical relations are secondary evidence packets; they do not move local seams, replace local speakers, or authorize claims beyond relation_type.
routing_policy.ranking: Rank the local Zechariah unit first, mandatory parent context second, and later canonical reuse third.
routing_policy.citation: Identify the local Zechariah span even when a later witness supplied query vocabulary.
routing_policy.proof_text_guard: If mandatory context is unavailable, abstain from synthesis and return the bounded local unit with context-incomplete warning.

mandatory_parent_context.reason: Rebuke, cleansing, Branch, and engraved stone are one courtroom-sign complex.
The Branch-temple oracle is anchored in Joshua crown sign and follows the closing night vision.
The king arrival and peaceful worldwide rule must remain joined within the burden.
Silver and potter language belongs to the rejected-shepherd sign-act.
Piercing, clan mourning, and the fountain form a cross-chapter movement.
The struck shepherd is completed by scattering, testing, and covenant renewal.
Mount intervention belongs to invasion, escape, cosmic change, waters, and kingship.
The no-Canaanite close crowns pilgrimage, judgment, and universal holiness.
